name: Scroll Morph Hero
summary: A tall hero where tiles start scattered, gather into a circle and then spread into an arc as the page scrolls, with the headline fading out.
useWhen: A landing page opens with a scroll-driven story about the product
Tiles, logos or screenshots need a short motion sequence without photos
avoidWhen: The page is a dense app screen or the hero must stay put, because the section is 260vh tall and sticks while scrolling; use a plain hero such as `hero-page/prism-hero` instead
Many large photos must load before the first paint, because each tile is drawn as its own element
